title: Great slab - Not for wood burning/crafts
text:
Great slab - Not for wood burning/crafts. NOT for CRAFTS. If I was a “Karen” I might give this a one star. But the wood itself is beautiful and wonderful … my biggest problem is the center core of all of the slabs have a hole cut out and a plug of a different kind of wood grain in the center. For wood-burning I cannot use this.

If it’s used as a centerpiece or some object is put on the center of the wood… then this would be a great product. If you’re using it for CRAFTS and want to show the whole wood grain under the art this is not the right wood as it shows the plug in the center.

It was well packaged with tissue paper just not the right wood for my art.
